handoff.purpose: Process entry points: console scripts, __main__.py, __main__ guards, dispatch chains, and poll loops; define helper _named_module_targets.

symbols.name: func_targets
symbols.note: Local function inside _entry_targets; resolves targets for a given function's closure.

symbols.name: _named_module_targets
symbols.note: Top-level function that resolves module-level bindings for named references.

claims.text: ``entry`` is the strongest claim in this report -- "a human types this and it runs". It is therefore the one claim that gets verified rather than believed: the module must exist AND define the named function.
claims.why: The chunk does not show the verification logic for 'entry' claims; it only handles console scripts, not the general entry verification.

claims.text: A dead target (`pkg = "pkg.cli:nosuchfunc"`) raises the moment anyone runs it, and granting it ``entry`` would paint the whole closure behind it green on the strength of a line in packaging metadata that nothing executes.
claims.why: The chunk does not contain the logic that assigns 'entry' kind or colors; it only collects broken console scripts.

claims.text: A dispatch chain in a module nothing can run is not a way in, and admitting it would invent entry points that no human or tool can actually take.
claims.why: The code iterates over entry_mods (modules that are already entry points) to process dispatch chains, thereby only adding dispatch chains from modules that are already entry points.

claims.text: HTTP handlers never import inside the branch; they call ``core.envelope`` or ``hierarchy.capabilities`` against a module-level import.
claims.why: The chunk does not contain any HTTP handler code; this claim is in the docstring of _named_module_targets and refers to external behavior not shown.

claims.text: Resolving the referenced name back through the import that bound it is the only way those routes reach anything.
claims.why: The implementation uses bound.get(ref) and _resolve, but the claim about 'only way' cannot be verified from this chunk alone.
